```
function setTrayStartDisplay(i,tr){
  const currentDayEl = document.getElementById('status-current-day'+i);
  const elapsedEl = document.getElementById('status-current-elapsed'+i);
  const dateEl = document.getElementById('status-start-date'+i);
  const timeEl = document.getElementById('status-start-time'+i);
  if(tr && Number.isFinite(Number(tr.start_unix)) && Number(tr.start_unix) > 0){
    const unix = Number(tr.start_unix);
    const startOffsetDays = Number.isFinite(Number(tr.start_day_offset)) ? Number(tr.start_day_offset) : 0;
    const offsetMs = startOffsetDays * 86400000;
    const effectiveUnixMs = unix * 1000 + offsetMs;
    const d = new Date(effectiveUnixMs);
    if(dateEl) dateEl.value = localDateStr(d);
    if(timeEl) timeEl.value = d.toTimeString().slice(0,5);
    if(currentDayEl) currentDayEl.textContent = String(tr.current_day || tr.day || '--');
    if(elapsedEl){
      const now = Date.now();
      const elapsed = Math.max(0, now - effectiveUnixMs);
      elapsedEl.textContent = `(${formatElapsedTime(elapsed)})`;
    }
  } else {
    if(dateEl) dateEl.value = todayStr();
    if(timeEl) timeEl.value = '17:00';
    if(currentDayEl) currentDayEl.textContent = '--';
    if(elapsedEl) elapsedEl.textContent = '';
  }
}

```
